name: batch-16
prompt:
Create ONE production game-icon SPRITE ATLAS, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows on a square canvas, ideally 2048x2048, genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha PNG. Input image is the user's approved style sheet, STYLE reference only. Match that soft tactile dimensional 3D collectible family: gentle warm upper-left diffuse studio light, rounded yet faithful forms, bright pastel/candy color, subtle ambient occlusion, restrained material detail. Each object's true material remains recognizable: paper, wood, glass, metal, woven cloth. No same-clay treatment on everything. No heavy dark outlines or flat vector art.

CRITICAL PACKAGING: There are EXACTLY NINE equal square virtual cells in a regular 3x3 grid. Draw ONE specified object/group centered within EACH virtual cell, at ONLY 48–52% of cell width/height, with at least 24% EMPTY TRANSPARENT MARGIN ON EVERY SIDE. Nothing may touch a virtual cell edge or cross into a neighbor. All strings, handles, leaves and shadows stay inside their own cell. Think SMALL MINIATURE ICONS with LARGE EMPTY GUTTERS, NOT large illustrations filling the sheet. Icon centers are x=16.67%,50%,83.33%, y=16.67%,50%,83.33% of the image. Each icon must fit in a box 18% of the overall image size. Empty space between shapes is essential. No visible grid lines, no backgrounds, no color squares, no borders, no captions, numbers, words, ID labels, titles or decorative props. Empty padding is genuine alpha transparency, NOT a drawn checkerboard. Top-left through bottom-right order is mandatory; do not swap cells. Each tile will be cropped at exact one-third boundaries into a separate icon. Keep centered and similarly weighted, readable at 32–66px. All objects fully in frame, no cropping. Only allow inscription glyphs explicitly specified in subject. Do not invent sacred symbols, cultural ornament, claims or text. No extra humans/hands/landscape/pedestals. Subject list in strict row-major order:
1. Cell row 1, column 1: A round tan wooden embroidery hoop with a small top fastener, ivory fabric and one dusty-rose stitched flower with green stem and leaves; preserve the original sparse floral design, without adding regional emblems.
2. Cell row 1, column 2: Nine ivory glazed ceramic tiles in a three-by-three square inside a warm brown wooden frame; each tile has a simple blue-and-teal four-petal motif with an ochre center, with all nine grout divisions visible.
3. Cell row 1, column 3: A miniature ochre painted wooden cart in side perspective, with a teal stripe on its rectangular box, one large visible cream-and-rust spoked wheel and a short reddish-brown shaft extending right; no horse, saint image or parade float.
4. Cell row 2, column 1: A blue indigo-dyed cotton cloth draped over a tan wooden drying rail, with an ivory central diamond outline and an ivory lower stripe; preserve the softly curved hanging hem and original simple resist-dye pattern.
5. Cell row 2, column 2: A small cream model-house facade with a centered brown doorway, teal geometric bands, one rust-colored diamond above the door and ochre lower accents; preserve the original simple painted fields without adding copied murals or clan symbols.
6. Cell row 2, column 3: A deep round warm-copper bowl seen slightly from above, with a thick rolled rim, darker open interior and a few shallow hammered highlights on the curved exterior; retain metal identity with restrained reflections.
7. Cell row 3, column 1: A pale golden birch-bark basket with a broad rectangular opening, tapered woven body, cream top binding and one tall arched handle; show the interlaced bark strips clearly, without adding contents or symbolic decoration.
8. Cell row 3, column 2: A miniature upright festival figure with a small peach face, ochre hat, teal jacket and sleeves, long terracotta bell-shaped skirt and one cream chest flower, standing on a low wooden base; no named character or copied crest.
9. Cell row 3, column 3: A muted sea-green hanging cloth banner on a tan wooden pole and crossbar, with a notched lower edge, a small cream sun disk and a cream wavy stripe; retain the original simple sun-and-wave design, without saints, crests or flags.
